_about: 2-Propanol (1) + Methanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 2-propanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 2-propanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: G. Zhang, B. L. Weeks, J. Wei, Vapor-Liquid Equilibria Data for Methanol + 2-Propanol+ 2-Methyl-2-butanol and Constituent Binary Systems at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 52 (2007) 878-883
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 7, 8. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0008. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.05 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
